services.title: How We Bu<highlight>i</highlight>ld
services.subtitle: Four phases. One philosophy. We guide you from vision to an extraordinary digital presence.
services.strategy_desc: We are your compass at the ideation stage. The partnership begins with crystallising your vision into a smart work plan - choosing the right tools and preventing costly mistakes at your product's foundation.
services.engineering_desc: We build with you from the ground up, down to the smallest detail. We take full technical ownership and turn a spec into a live, robust, polished system that grows with your ambitions.
services.performance_desc: We create a digital experience that feels right. We translate your values into visual language and fluid motion that makes users stop, feel, and connect with your story.
services.step_1_desc: Before anything is built, we immerse ourselves in your world - asking the right questions, mapping your landscape, and turning ambition into a clear strategic direction.
services.step_2_desc: Every flow, every interaction, every screen is built around your users. We translate strategy into experience - intuitive, refined, and unmistakably yours.
services.step_3_desc: Where design meets code. We engineer with the care of a master craftsman - pixel-perfect, performant, and built to hold under real-world pressure.
services.step_4_headline: We launch with you, not for you.
services.step_4_desc: Going live is the beginning, not the end. We stand alongside you through launch, growth, and every iteration that follows.

projects.title: Case Stud<highlight>i</highlight>es
projects.subtitle: Selected case studies - each one a system built to solve a real problem, shipped on schedule, and designed to last.
projects.yup_desc: Yup.io was a growing SaaS platform held back by a legacy frontend that couldn't match the product's scale. We redesigned the core architecture - refactoring legacy components into a modern React and TailwindCSS system that performs fast, ships clean, and supports the product's next stage of growth.
projects.yup_alt: Yup.io SaaS platform - legacy frontend refactored into a React and TailwindCSS production architecture
projects.bullshit_desc: NFC-tagged artworks existed in physical isolation - no digital discovery layer, no global reach. We built a full-stack geospatial platform with Next.js 15 and MapboxGL on the frontend, backed by Node/Express/TypeScript and MongoDB geospatial queries - turning every scanned piece into a live pin on a world map.
projects.bullshit_alt: Full-stack geospatial web application built with Next.js, MapboxGL, and Node.js
projects.michal_desc: An artist needed a digital presence that put the work front and centre - no clutter, no friction. We built a minimal gallery site with smooth scroll animations, fully responsive layouts, and a clean visual language that gets out of the way and lets the art speak.
projects.michal_alt: Artist gallery website built with Next.js and TailwindCSS
projects.better_desc: Ofir needed a fully Hebrew RTL digital presence for her personal coaching and events practice - one she could manage independently without a developer. We built a WCAG 2.1 AA accessible one-page site with Decap CMS integration, giving Ofir full control over content, images, and events without touching a line of code.
projects.better_alt: Hebrew RTL landing page for personal coach Ofir - built with React, Vite, TailwindCSS, and Decap CMS with full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
projects.sanctuary_desc: Therapists needed a digital presence that spoke their language - calm, trustworthy, and human. We built a site that explains the value of a digital presence in the therapeutic world's own terms, pairing Next.js performance with Decap CMS so clients can manage their content independently.
projects.sanctuary_alt: The Digital Sanctuary - therapist-focused website built with Next.js, Decap CMS, and RTL support
projects.pic_desc: The event production industry was fragmented - producers ran shows from WhatsApp, vendors lived by word of mouth, and party-goers were always a step behind. PIC needed a landing page that could speak to three distinct audiences at once without losing clarity or conversion power.
projects.pic_alt: PIC Events - lead generation landing page for an event production platform connecting producers, vendors, and party-goers

pillars.yup_challenge: Yup.io was a growing SaaS platform held back by a legacy frontend that couldn't match the product's velocity. Component bloat, inconsistent patterns, and a fragile style layer were slowing every release.
pillars.yup_result: We redesigned the core architecture - refactoring legacy components into a modern React and TailwindCSS system that performs fast, ships clean, and supports the product's next stage of growth.
pillars.bullshit_challenge: NFC-tagged artworks existed in physical isolation - no digital discovery layer, no global reach. Each piece was invisible the moment it left the gallery wall.
pillars.bullshit_result: We built a full-stack geospatial platform with Next.js 15, MapboxGL, and MongoDB geospatial queries - turning every scanned piece into a live pin on a world map.
pillars.michal_challenge: An artist needed a digital presence that put the work front and centre. Existing templates imposed structure that competed with the art instead of framing it.
pillars.michal_result: We built a minimal gallery site with smooth scroll animations, fully responsive layouts, and a clean visual language that gets out of the way and lets the art speak.
pillars.better_challenge: The goal was to eliminate technical friction. Ofir needed a digital presence that reflected her professional precision while granting her total independence to manage content and events without relying on a developer.
pillars.better_result: We engineered a seamless balance between high-end UI and a custom-fitted CMS. The result is a fully accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) platform that empowers her to lead her practice with confidence, supported by invisible yet robust technology.
pillars.sanctuary_challenge: The goal was to speak the therapists' language. Therapists needed to understand why a digital presence matters - but existing solutions felt cold and technical, far removed from the calm and trust at the heart of therapeutic work.
pillars.sanctuary_result: We created a space that explains the necessity of a digital presence while maintaining the calm and trust essential to the therapeutic world. Clean design and quiet technology support the therapeutic relationship and turn digital exposure into a simple, respectful process.
pillars.pic_challenge: The event production industry had no shared infrastructure - producers coordinated through WhatsApp, vendors relied purely on word of mouth, and party-goers always heard about the best events after the fact. PIC is a first-of-its-kind platform serving three distinct audiences at once. The challenge was building a landing page that could make an ambitious, complex product feel instantly clear and compelling to each of them.
pillars.pic_result: We built a high-conversion lead generation landing page that walks producers, vendors, and party-goers through a single, seamless narrative - surfacing PIC's unique differentiators (smart matching algorithm, digital ticket album, tiered pricing) without overwhelming the visitor. The structure, copy hierarchy, and CTA architecture were engineered to turn a three-sided marketplace pitch into a focused, persuasive experience that drives signups.
